input.change_text: SDK: `mcp_authenticate` now supports `redirectUri` for custom scheme completion and claude.ai connectors

output.subject: mcp_authenticate now accepts redirectUri for custom schemes
output.action_text: Pass `redirectUri` to `mcp_authenticate` when building a custom-scheme OAuth callback or a claude.ai connector. Lets desktop apps complete OAuth via `myapp://callback` style URIs instead of localhost-only flows.
